card.text: Explore Thule in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Thule is a outer-belt asteroid. Explore its calibrated convex reconstruction from DAMIT, version 2025-07-17. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. Two published pole solutions remain; this view uses model 16313.

shape.title: DAMIT model 16313
shape.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
